copy.name: TextButler
copy.promise: An AI butler in your messaging apps.
open: Your phone keeps buzzing while you’re busy.
Most of it is one quick question.

steps.heading: Just say butler
steps.body: Someone you turned on texts “butler”. It answers for you, from your Mac.

steps.heading: Always marked
steps.body: Every butler message is wrapped in 🤖{ }. 👀 goes out first.

steps.heading: Your choice of writer
steps.body: A local model, your Claude Code, Codex or Devin subscription, or your own key.

steps.heading: Check it first
steps.body: Ask for a suggestion instead. Nothing sends until you type send.

proof.caption: Defaults for every chat you turn on.

limits.heading: What it won’t do
limits.body: It stays out of group chats, and it never pretends to be you.
